title: Analyze Relations
description: Returns relationship details of threat data objects within Intel Exchange.

body.name: ids
body.description: Pass a list of threat object IDs.

items.description: This is an example ID.

body.name: next
body.description: Returns the pagination link to the next page.

body.name: page_size
body.description: Returns the number of results retrieved per page.

body.name: previous
body.description: Returns the pagination link to the previous page.

body.name: results
body.description: Returns the relationship details of threat data object

items.name: hi
items.description: Returns `true` if the threat data object is hidden in the threat investigation canvas, else returns `false`.

items.name: id
items.description: Returns the ID of the threat data object or the relationship type.

items.name: prop
items.description: Returns additional information about the threat data object or the relationship type.

items.name: analyst_score
items.description: Returns the analyst-assigned score.

items.name: analyst_tlp
items.description: Returns the analyst-assigned score.

items.name: confidence_score
items.description: Returns the confidence score of the object.

items.name: confidence_type
items.description: Returns the confidence type of the object.

items.name: country
items.description: Returns the geographic information about the object source.

items.name: created
items.description: Returns the Unix timestamp when the indicator was created.

items.name: first_seen
items.description: Returns when the object was first observed.

items.name: id
items.description: Returns the unique identifier for the threat object.

items.name: identifier
items.description: Returns the internal system identifier for the threat object.

items.name: indicator_type
items.description: Returns the type of the object.

items.name: is_actioned
items.description: Boolean indicating if the threat has been actioned.

items.name: is_deprecated
items.description: Boolean indicating whether the object is outdated.

items.name: is_false_positive
items.description: Boolean indicating if this was marked as a false positive.

items.name: is_reviewed
items.description: Boolean indicating whether this threat has been reviewed by an analyst.

items.name: is_revoked
items.description: Boolean indicating whether this threat has been reviewed by an analyst.

items.name: is_whitelisted
items.description: Boolean indicating the indicator is allowed/safe.

items.name: label
items.description: Returns the label for the object type.

items.name: last_seen
items.description: Returns the last time the indicator was observed

items.name: modified
items.description: Returns the Unix timestamp for the last modification of the object.

items.name: name
items.description: Returns the name of the object.

items.name: published_collections
items.description: Returns the Unix timestamp for the last modification of the indicator.

items.name: severity
items.description: Returns the threat severity information.

items.name: source_collections
items.description: Returns the collections from which the indicator originated.

items.name: source_confidence
items.description: Returns the confidence level of the source.

items.name: sources
items.description: Returns the details of the source

items.name: id
items.description: Returns the unique identifier of the source.

items.name: name
items.description: Returns the name of the source.

items.name: source_type
items.description: Returns the type of the source.

items.name: subscriber_collections
items.description: Returns the collections that have subscribed to this threat.

items.name: subscribers
items.description: List of subscribers to this object.

items.name: tags
items.description: Returns the list of associated tags.

items.name: tlp
items.description: Returns the associated TLP.

items.name: type
items.description: Returns the type of the object.

items.name: valid_from
items.description: Returns the Unix timestamp for when the indicator becomes valid.

items.name: valid_until
items.description: Returns the Unix timestamp for when the indicator expires.

items.name: t
items.description: Returns the value of the threat data object or the relationship type.

items.name: type
items.description: Returns one of the following

items.name: u
items.description: Returns an endpoint to the image of a node in the canvas.

body.name: total
body.description: Returns the total number of items on a page.
